assignment_text: Prepare a five-slide presentation explaining a proposed improvement to a public service. Include the problem, evidence, mechanism, trade-offs and conclusion.
context_pack_text: Purpose: explain how a source-grounded presentation can make an argument inspectable. Audience: master's students and course examiners. Thesis: reviewable stages help students correct an argument before slide design. Open question: whether the extra review step saves time overall.

outline.title: The presentation problem
outline.key_message: A polished deck can hide a weak argument.

outline.title: Requirements and evidence
outline.key_message: Students must satisfy a brief and support claims with sources.

outline.title: Review before design
outline.key_message: An editable outline exposes decisions early.

outline.title: Local edits versus full rebuilds
outline.key_message: A local revision should preserve accepted work.

outline.title: What the pilot must show
outline.key_message: Students should retain control of both evidence and the final file.
